title: Overlapping exposures linked from the anchor into one map
caption: From the September proposal: four overlapping exposures of a render, the first with the sacral anchor in the field, and the panorama they make, every body a node counted from the anchor 0 to 8.

source.notes: Extracted from the second image embedded in the artifact's page (alt text 'overlapping frames stitched'), downscaled from 1,734 to 1,400 pixels wide. The page names no script for it; the 20:12 figures page captions the same panel 'The sweep on a real render', so it is render work.

rerun.cost: needs the renders on the grid and a script the page does not name
